required_gates.requirement: Frozen R3 archive and exact copied source hashes preserved; no private baseline required by public reproducer.
22 retained core regression tests pass, no skip, on new PostgreSQL 18.7 cluster.
Official SDK initialize/list/call across all three separate bridge servers; protocol recorded.
Five fixed scenarios, three arms and three repetitions executed; trace hashes and interventions preserved.
Independent integrity oracle and literal predeclared task/checkpoint oracle; matched logical outcomes/business states, B/C observations equivalent.
Optimized conventional control and information-equivalent enriched control; raw requests/refusals/normalized bytes/timing disclosed without imposed advantage.
Permissions and projection bounded on bridge paths; no feedback export bypass or identity/cost tool argument.
Real SDK transport interruption after commit by attested server PID; restart same key yields one effect.
Public allowlist, secret/path/chat exclusion scan, exact source manifest and dependency provenance reviewed.
Distinct code reviewer and real ChatGPT initial/final review bound to current source/design IDs; blocking objections closed.
Actual public repository and prerelease on verified commit; observed CI, release download SHA matches; no invented URL.
Published report states local deterministic scope, equal-information result, no LLM/customer/production/novelty claims and real remaining external steps.

success: All required gates pass with real version-bound reviews and verified public release. No algorithmic gain is required.
